June 3 37.

My dear Steptoe,

In reply to your letter of 31st May, 1937,
I have to inform you that Hugh Gilmer, British subject,
aged 38, arrived in Shanghai from Japan on board the
s.s."Fushima Maru" on May 17, 1937. Accompanied by a
Japanese he is believed to have visited the Oriental
Hotel (Sincere's), 690 Nanking Road, where he remained
for a few hours and then left stating that he was leaving
Shanghai immediately. His destination and the identity
of the Japanese who accompanied him are unknown.

On his alien declaration form, Gilmer stated
that he was visiting Shanghai as a tourist and that he
would remain in China for two or three weeks. His passport
number was given as British A. 161913 issued in Sydney,
N.S.W. on June 5, 1935, and visaed in Melbourne, Vic.,
on September 19, 1935.

Gilmer's photograph is returned herewith.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.

（批：Enclosed 76
usb）

H.M.Steptoe,Esq.,
H.B.M.Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1937年6月3日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

就您1937年5月31日的来信，兹复函告知：英国籍人士休·吉尔默（Hugh Gilmer），38岁，于1937年5月17日乘“福岛丸”号（Fushima Maru）轮船从日本抵达上海。据信，他由一名日本人陪同，曾前往南京路690号的东方饭店（先施公司附属），停留数小时后离去，并称将立即离开上海。其目的地及陪同他的那名日本人的身份均不详。

吉尔默在其外侨申报表中称，他以游客身份访问上海，并将在华停留两至三周。其护照号码为英国A. 161913号，1935年6月5日签发于新南威尔士州悉尼，1935年9月19日在维多利亚州墨尔本加盖签证。

随函附上吉尔默的照片。

此致

敬礼

（签名）K. M. 伯恩（Bourne）

（批注：附件 76
